campaign_analysis.product_category: AI-powered marketing intelligence and optimization platform

image_prompts.prompt: High-quality editorial documentary photography, shot on a 28mm lens at chest height with f/11 for edge-to-edge sharpness, featuring a modern loft-style analytics war room with exposed-brick walls and large industrial-style windows. Two distinct members of the marketing audience are mid-conversation around a rectangular warm wooden table: one woman in a sharp dark blue blazer over a light blouse with shoulder-length dark brown hair, intently looking at her open laptop; and one man in a crisp white button-down shirt with rolled-up sleeves and a short beard, gesturing towards her screen while discussing. Each laptop screen displays an analytics dashboard with the single word "Spenzo" in a bold sans-serif font rendered in #FF6B35 brand color as the dashboard header, and below it rectangular color cards and simple bar/line shapes with no readable labels. A large wall-mounted monitor in the background also displays the "Spenzo" dashboard in the same style. The table is dressed with a plate of croissants, one glass of fresh orange juice, one green matcha juice, two clear water glasses, three white porcelain espresso cups, a small green potted plant as a centerpiece, a notebook with a black pen, and loose papers. A subtle #FF6B35 orange accent appears on a laptop sticker. Abundant bright sunlight streams from the left through the industrial windows, casting warm golden highlights and distinct, gentle shadows. The color grade is vibrant and natural with rich wood tones. The top-left corner features a calm section of the exposed brick wall. No text, no logos, no UI mockups (except the "Spenzo" dashboard header), no bokeh, no shallow depth of field, no background blur.

Around the standing-height dark wooden conference table, five other team members are attentive: one man in a bright striped sweater (red/white/blue) with short blond hair; one man in a gray blazer over a white shirt with a short beard; one woman in a black blazer with long straight brown hair, taking notes on her laptop; one woman in a subtly patterned checked shirt with shoulder-length curly hair; and one man with thick curly dark hair and glasses in a dark blue button-down shirt. The large wall-mounted monitor in the background, and all open laptops, display analytics dashboards with the single word "Spenzo" in a bold sans-serif font rendered in #FF6B35 brand color as the dashboard header, and below it rectangular color cards and simple bar/line shapes with no readable labels.
